newsitem.title: USA: Mercury Finance to buy back 9 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Mercury Finance to buy back 9 mln shares.

text.p: Mercury Finance Co said Tuesday its directors authorized the repurchase of up to nine million of its 173 million common shares in the open market or in privately negotiated transactions over the next 24 months.
Mercury Finance said it had bought back about 4.5 million shares under a previous authorization.

All shares repurchased will be held in the company's treasury for possible acquisitions, employee benefit plans, stock dividends, stock splits and other corporate purposes, the company said in a statement.
Shares of Mercury Finance, a specialty consumer finance company, were trading up 1/2 to 10-5/8.
